description_en: Cancels or interrupts an ongoing chat
kebab_example: aliyun chatbot cancel-chat --agent-key ac627989eb4f8a98ed05fd098bbae5_p_beebot_public --session-id c1187530338311ebade7cf3eaeb3668a --chat-id 7105a351-b2e7-4c9e-8437-c43a043c0a4e --instance-id chatbot-cn-yjzbyrEvqd --type Canceled --answer '这个答案被打' --api-version 2022-04-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CancelChat

parameters.help_en: The agent key. If unspecified, the default agent is used. You can obtain the key on the Business Management page of your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间key，不传时访问默认业务空间，key值在主账号业务管理页面获取
parameters.name: agent_key

parameters.help_en: The session ID is used to identify a visitor's session and maintain context. For a new visitor, omit this parameter in the first call to the chat operation. The chatbot starts a session and returns the session ID in the response. For subsequent turns, you must pass the session ID to maintain context. The value can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 会话ID，用于标识一个访问者的会话和保持上下文信息。对于一个新的访问者，首次调用Chat接口时无需传递此字段，机器人会开启一个会话，并在Chat接口的响应中返回该会话的SessionId。对于该访问者的后续轮次的会话，调用Chat接口时传递当前会话的SessionId，机器人即可基于SessionId继续该轮次会话。长度限制是64个字符
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The ID that identifies a single chat turn
parameters.name: chat_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the chatbot instance
parameters.name: instance_id

CancelResult.description_en: Indicates whether the operation was successful
